done_when: Lockfiles and base images are updated within their allowed ranges, the image builds and the test command passes

dismissals.because: docker-compose.yml:3 the repo has no Dockerfile or app image (Render builds the API natively, docs/architecture/deployment.md); its only base image is postgres:18-alpine in docker-compose.yml and .github/workflows/ci.yml:29, a floating tag that always resolves to the newest 18.x patch, so it is already updated within its range with nothing to build; the lockfile refresh passed install, lint, typecheck, tests and both builds

findings.body: This branch updates the pnpm lockfile, but changes no base-image reference. The supplied close run passes install, lint, typecheck, tests, and the web/API builds; it shows no container-image build. Update the base-image reference within its allowed range and build the image to verify the remaining acceptance criteria.
findings.title: Not done: Lockfiles and base images are updated within their allowed ranges, the image builds and the test command passes

why: Dependencies and base images are over a week old, so new security advisories fail the image scan
